label: r2
kind: MODEL judgement, not a human one

judge.order: balanced A/B per pass, shuffled with a seeded mulberry32

prompt.intro: You are shown two screenshots of a browser 3D hover-board flight game (a rider gliding over a canal valley with a village, aqueduct arches and glowing signal rings), labelled Image A and Image B. Both are taken at the same moment of the same recorded run (same game state), at the same window size. Exactly one of them is from the original, shipped game; the other is from an independent re-implementation that tries to reproduce it. Judge everything visible: the 3D scene (sky, terrain, water, buildings, rider, rings, lighting), the on-screen HUD and any title card.
prompt.question: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, with these keys: "same_game": true if a player would take both for the same game with the same art direction, false otherwise; "same_game_confidence": a number from 0 to 1; "original": "A" or "B", whichever you believe is the original shipped game (you must choose one); "original_confidence": a number from 0.5 to 1; "tells": up to three short phrases naming the visible differences that drove your choice.
